status: conditional spectral-closure comparison; not a calibrated attack law

method.interpretation: Each landmark is a relative spectral-ratio drop. Filter cutoff, overdrive and changing layer balance can alter this trajectory; elapsed time is not the filter attack duration.
method.latency_compensation: Subtract known retained renderer latency from time coordinates only; no signal shift, EQ, gain or timing fit.
method.frame_grid: Each original PCM uses its own fixed44-sample hop; no interpolation to fit crossings.
method.selection: Rank first-note probes only when every paired landmark is observed; censored timing remains unknown.

interpretation: No probe has every first-note landmark observed; missing crossings are censored, not zero, so no complete-landmark timing winner is identified.
limitations: Original performance MIDI is unavailable. The author .mid file contains patch SysEx, not note events.
Onsets are approximately within 10–15 ms. Adjoining gates do not identify exact key release, overlap or mono retrigger history; test +/-15 ms gate changes when drawing envelope conclusions.
Velocity 100 is a placeholder. The original velocities, controllers, system tuning/transpose and exact recorded patch revision remain unknown.

Short-window periodic fits measure approximately 13–26 cents below A=440 in this passage. Filter/overdrive phase and changing envelope can bias the estimate; this reconstruction does not add pitch bend or retune the patch to fit those measurements.

A02 has no enabled internal spatial send, but its Upper overdrive and moving filter couple oscillator families. This is a joint patch comparison, not a direct pulse-width or oscillator-gain calibration.
The comparison starts after silence preceding the first selected attack. Prior lower-part release or capture processing may remain; no unsupported controller history is invented.
All timestamps refer to the directly decoded YouTube source. SoundCloud is a separate lossy copy and is not the time origin of this reconstruction.
The other four notes are sensitivity observations from the same performance, not independent recordings.
Channels, windows and onset shifts are correlated analysis settings, not independent experimental trials.
Spectral-ratio closure reflects filter, drive and layer balance jointly. Crossing elapsed time is not filter attack duration.
The ratio metric cancels constant gain; raw unnormalised WAVs were used with no EQ or parameter fitting.
